validation.source_timing_note: 44-test run preceded the root agent final evaluator metadata wording update; source_sha256 records the latest files when this receipt was created. The modified evaluator was not executed.

interface.default: CPU preflight only; --execute required for actual batch
interface.reference_files: <reference-panel>/seed<seed>/initial-state.pt; all five SHA256 values must match frozen manifest
interface.supervision: POSIX parent owns a dedicated worker process group; model and simulator descendants inherit the group. Parent kills the entire owned group on exit/timeout. Infrastructure failures stop remaining cases, retaining all five planned rows.
interface.gpu_guard: Physical GPU1 exact UUID, memory <1024 MiB, utilization 0, no compute processes; evaluator checks renderer PCI before actions. No GPU0 mutation.
interface.repeat_and_handoff: Not implemented by this launcher; no automatic repeat, navigation, handoff or API calls.

candidate_gate.development_evidence: Selected and baseline dev JSON and NPZ files must exist and match all four recorded SHA256 values. Recompute score from first-action/valid-chunk active11 RMSE ratios; require score <1 and both reach yaw/torso RMSE <=1.1 times baseline. No validation_action_loss field is invented or required.
candidate_gate.checkpoint_identity: best/<step> must match selected step 1..500. Once a real model server is ready, its restored parameter SHA must equal best.json checkpoint_parameters_sha256; baseline uses original best855 identity.
candidate_gate.manifest: Frozen protocol manifest includes runtime source hashes, normalizer hash, all five initial-state hashes, fixed protocol/settings and candidate best_json_sha256. Regenerate and review the frozen manifest after any source change.
